_comment: Store listing copy that is not the changelog. `file` names a capture that scripts/verify-windows.ps1 writes to target/verify/; the release build ships them in listing order. Captions are limited to 200 characters, the trailer title to 255.

screenshots.caption: Your coding agent proposes an architecture on the canvas and flags the choices it needs you to make.
The Decisions panel lists every choice still waiting on you, and steps through them one at a time.
Pick an option and the agent, blocked on await_decisions, receives your answer and carries on.
Edit the graph yourself: add, rename, connect, and remove components, with full undo and redo.
The session timeline records everything the agent and you did, in order.
Compare two sessions side by side to see how a design changed between attempts.
Seven themes in light and dark, matched to the native Windows title bar.

trailerTitle: Nodestorm: the canvas your coding agent draws on
